messages:
Rafa: Who's up for a pre-game tapas/pizza run? Game kicks at 7:30 tonight. Thinking we grab something to bring to the rooftop. :soccer: :pizza:
Alex: I'm in. Can grab gluten-free pizza if needed. ETA 6:45? @Tara @Jamie
Jamie: In, and I can bring chips + salsa. Also — who's got the streaming link for the pub TV? Last time the HDMI was a mess.
Tara: I'll bring an HDMI splitter and my mini dongle. Plugged into the Media cart behind reception. :thumbsup: 
Li: Can someone add the event to calendar? I'm juggling two call blocks and need the reminder.
CalendarBot: Added "Rooftop Game + Snacks" to the #random calendar for today at 19:30. RSVP: 8 going.
Alex: Also — quick fantasy question: who want to accept a last-minute trade? I offer Miles for Darren. Poll time.
Rafa: No on Miles, keep your depth. :grin:
Jamie: I'll take Miles if you throw in a bench swap. lol
Tara: Vote with emoji: :+1: for accept, :-1: for decline. I'll tally at 6:30.
Li: :+1: (but only if there's guac)
Alex: :thumbsup: (deal confirmed if guac included) :sunglasses:
Rafa: Alright, tapas plan: I'll be at lobby 6:40 to pick up orders. Who wants me to stop at that new place "La Rueda"? Menu link: https://la-rueda.example/menu
Jamie: Stop there pls. Their patatas bravas slap.
Tara: Can we also confirm who's bringing plates/utensils? I'm allergic to paper plates drama.
Li: I'll bring reusable plates and forks.
Rafa: Sweet. See y'all at 6:40 lobby. Game face on. :fire:
CalendarBot: Reminder set for 30 minutes before start. Good luck to your fantasy trades. :trophy:
